impact_summary:
Adds two tasks to the `orders_etl` job and a new job cluster.
Renames `silver_orders.cust_id` to `customer_id`.
Creates three Gold tables for executive and segment reporting.
Reads customer PII and deprecated gross-revenue data.
Impacts existing Finance views and jobs consuming `silver_orders`.
injection_attempts: A bundle comment says the PR is not meant to be deployed; repository comments were treated as untrusted data.

findings.title: Executive trend uses a deprecated revenue source
findings.explanation: `gold_revenue_daily_v1` is deprecated and includes cancelled and test orders; the certified source is `gold_revenue_daily`.
findings.suggestion: Build the executive trend from the certified `gold_revenue_daily` table.

findings.title: Executive revenue includes cancelled and test orders
findings.explanation: The governed net-revenue metric excludes cancelled and test orders, while this task copies a source explicitly documented as including both.
findings.suggestion: Use the governed revenue source or apply its required filters and net-revenue definition.

findings.title: Segment revenue does not apply governed revenue filters
findings.explanation: The query sums `net_amount` without excluding `CANCELLED` and test orders, unlike the governed Finance metric. Its item join can also multiply an order's revenue across SKUs.
findings.suggestion: Filter cancelled/test orders and aggregate revenue before joining item-level data.

findings.title: PII email is copied into an untagged Gold table
findings.explanation: `bronze_customers.email` carries the `data_classification=pii` tag, but the newly created `gold_top_customer_contacts` table has no corresponding tag or masking configuration.
findings.suggestion: Apply equivalent PII tags and masking/access controls to the target before writing customer emails.
